@Bettina Kroll: Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 2 Nov 2025 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." So the date for your tracker is **3 November 2025**.

The digest doesn't name Kwame as the new owner. The Coastal cheat sheet does list Pellucid Harbor Logistics under the Coastal accounts, but it doesn't give a handover date. The date comes from that one digest. Also, "PHL" is sometimes used for both Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Covey & Lark Retail (now Pellow Home Living), so check which account you mean when you log it.
